analysis_spec.df_rule: valid_starts - 1 (df=3 with 4 valid starts; df=2 with 3)
analysis_spec.estimand: T(row, column) = mean over valid starts (4 planned, >=3 required) of the 5-block mean completion_fenced_us_per_forward for that frozen column on that evaluation capture
analysis_spec.holm_secondary: Holm-Bonferroni adjusted p-values within each layer (family = 12 primary contrasts), descriptive sensitivity only; never alters the pre-registered verdict; confirmatory use requires a NEW protocol
analysis_spec.layer_indeterminate: >=2 rows with fewer than 3 valid starts
mandatory_reporting: the complete per-layer 4x5 cell matrix: cell estimates, per-start values, within-block paired CIs for all 20 pairs, not only the 12 own-vs-other contrasts
per-row best column and its delta versus identity and versus own base
descriptive oracle gaps (row-equal K and K-tilde weighted, with the assumption note)
pairwise column displacement counts and frozen C_batch migration-cost context

migration_context_descriptive.estimator: C_batch(k) = reference_cost_per_displaced_expert_us * moves_k; CROSS-CAPTURE EXTRAPOLATION - descriptive context only, never in verdicts

oracle_gap_descriptive.k_tilde_assumption_note_mandatory: K_tilde = evaluation token shares, an EXOGENOUS approximation of each domain's service relevance; CD-X0 rows are NOT equal-token (book ~2x, code ~4x the sharegpt/prover row sizes), so K_tilde weighting is an assumption-flagged approximation, not a replay-measured quantity; no service-share multiplication may be applied to these numbers and no full-service benefit or harm may be inferred in either direction
oracle_gap_descriptive.t_static: min over the 5 columns of sum_d K_d T(x_d, column)
oracle_gap_descriptive.t_switch: sum_d K_d min over columns of T(x_d, column)

analysis_spec.paired_contrasts: within-capture start-level means of within-block paired differences; all 10 within-row column pairs reported per row (superset of the amendment-4 20-pair floor); primaries oriented as T(other-base) - T(own-base), positive = own base faster
analysis_spec.primary_family: 24 primary paired contrasts = 2 layers x 4 rows x 3 own-vs-other-base; EXPLORATORY screening only; no family-wise error rate control claimed
analysis_spec.row_tracks_own_base: all three other-base-minus-own-base paired 95% CIs exclude zero positively
analysis_spec.row_with_fewer_valid_starts: indeterminate row; retired starts never retried

verdict_rule.detected: >=1 of the 2 layers shows clear crossover advantage
verdict_rule.indeterminate: any layer indeterminate and none clear
verdict_rule.not_detected: 0 layers show it and no layer is indeterminate
verdict_rule.verdict_wording_constraint: verdicts speak ONLY about the chosen layers and candidates at replay caliber; never about whole-service benefit or harm in either direction; not_detected is NOT evidence of absence of exploitable cross-domain structure

cdx0_study_spec.within_block_column_order: deterministic rotation of the frozen five-column order by (start_index + block_index) mod 5; start_index is the 0-based index of the start in this protocol's starts list

candidate.applies_to: versus_captured_output and versus_identity_replay comparisons for every layout; identity comparisons are trivially exact against themselves

identity_versus_captured.strict_equivalence_note: enforced via max_abs_error <= atol on the identity-versus-captured comparison, which at rtol=0 is exactly equivalent to zero isclose failures under the strict bound

design.failed_start_handling: failure record written, start retired, campaign CONTINUES (amendment v1 execution discipline; implements the frozen <3-valid-starts row rule)
design.fresh_start_semantics: one torchrun process group per start; every start reloads all immutable artifacts and rebuilds weights before warmup
design.matrix: rows = four evaluation-domain captures per layer; columns = identity + calibration-greedy base of each domain reused verbatim across the layer's rows; 2 layers x 4 rows x 5 columns = 40 timed cells in this one campaign
design.response_definition: start-level contrast T(a) - T(b) for two columns of the same capture = mean of the five paired block effects; each block effect is completion_fenced_us_per_forward(a) - completion_fenced_us_per_forward(b) within the same rotated block

generator.schedule_rule: deterministic rotation of the frozen five-column order by (start_index + block_index) mod 5; start_index is the 0-based index of the start in this protocol's starts list

amendment_scope_reaffirmation.cells_and_starts_frozen: 40 timed cells and 32 replay starts; NO extension path is exercised by this amendment
amendment_scope_reaffirmation.next_step_after_pilot: use the full matrix plus the existing five-arm control trajectories (W deviation, reset classification, cumulative-cost decomposition) to decide CONCRETE correction rules for the controller; developing/validating any corrected controller happens on the calibration split only; the old controller's failure results remain on disk and in git history unchanged; the pilot does NOT automatically chain into another large ablation
amendment_scope_reaffirmation.no_service_experiment: the 30-start paired-order service experiment remains NOT proposed; nothing in CD-X0 authorizes it
amendment_scope_reaffirmation.no_significance_driven_starts: if the outcome is indeterminate, it is reported as indeterminate; no additional starts are launched under this pilot
amendment_scope_reaffirmation.verdict_scope: results judge only the cross-domain execution-time response among the chosen captures, the two layers (024, 071) and the candidate layouts at replay caliber; NO full-service benefit or harm conversion in either direction; NO multiplication by service token/time shares in any verdict or headline number

scope.hardware_software_lock: one node, 8x NVIDIA H20, EP=8, DeepEP normal dispatch/combine, DeepGEMM FP8, Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 (128 logical experts, top-8, 16 local/rank, 128-row alignment); identical model/service/replay tooling as crosstab_v1 (frozen code lock to be hash-verified at launch)

pilot_scope_statement.explicitly_not_answered: whether any whole-service (full-model, live scheduling) benefit or harm exists - no service-caliber extrapolation, no break-even claim, no multiplication by service-time shares in any verdict
pilot_scope_statement.opportunity_vs_exploitability_separation: replay harness contains NO controller; this pilot measures OPPORTUNITY only. Exploitability by the old controller is answered separately from existing five-arm logs (see results/ea_v1/workload_variation/log_check_w_reset_cost.json). Any future controller revision is developed and validated on calibration split only; the five-arm A11/A00 failure record is retained verbatim, never rewritten or re-run.
pilot_scope_statement.question: On 2 pre-specified layers, do 4 per-domain calibration-greedy layouts show a clear cross-domain crossover advantage (rows track own base) over 4 per-domain evaluation captures?

timing.schedule_algorithm: deterministic rotation of the frozen five-column order by (start_index + block_index) mod 5; every column is timed in every block and every position appears exactly once per start
